VIENTO MEDIODÍA / REFERENCIAS DE MAR DE: Midday wind / sea references for the whole day.
VIENTO MEDIODÍA / REFERENCIAS DEL MAR DE: Midday wind / sea references for 7:30 in the evening.
Midday wind / sea references for the whole day.
Midday wind / sea references for the whole day. No observation was made.
Midday wind / sea references for nightfall.
VIENTO MEDIODÍA. REFERENCIAS DE MAR DE T: Midday wind. Sea references for the whole day. No observation was made.
VIENTO, MAR Y DESCRIPTORES DEL AMANECER,: Wind, sea and descriptors at dawn, the rest at midday.
VIENTO: MEDODÍA / MAR: ANOCHECER O AMANE: Wind: midday / Sea: nightfall or dawn.
Fourth row is the chronometer longitude.
VIERDEN DE VERJAARDAG VAN DE KONING DER: Celebrated the birthday of the King of the Netherlands.
VIERDEN DE VERJAARDAG VAN H.M. DE KONING: Celebrated the birthday of Her Majesty the Queen. Promotions followed.
VIEREN DE 6-JARIGE VERLOSSING VAN HOLLAN: Celebrate the 6-year deliverance of Holland from French violence, or the restoration of Dutch freedom.
VIEREN HET FEEST VAN NEPTUNES, VERSCHILL: Celebrate the feast of Neptune; several people are promoted and are named by name.
VIEREN VERJAARDAG VAN OUDE KONINGIN EN V: Celebrate the birthday of the old Queen and of the independence gained. Lower the flags at sunset.
VIJAND SCHOOT MET SCHERP OP ONZE VAARTUI: The enemy fired live rounds at our vessels.
VINGE EEN ZEEVARKEN OF ANDERS GENAAMT EE: Caught a sea pig, otherwise called a tuna, having a beak shaped like a bird's and also entrails, ribs and tongue like another pig.
VINGEN 2 HAAIEN WAARVAN 1 EEN NOG LEESBA: Caught 2 sharks, one of which had a still legible love letter in its stomach.
VINGEN 3 KABBELJAUWEN EEN HEYLBOT EN EEN: Caught 3 cod, a halibut and a flatfish.
VINGEN 3 VLIEGENDE VISSEN DIE BINNEN BOO: Caught 3 flying fish that flew on board.
VINGEN 5 KABBELJAUWEN EEN HEIJLBOT 3 LOM: Caught 5 cod, a halibut, 3 lumpfish, a coalfish and two [?].
VINGEN DE EERSTE VIS SINDS DE KAAP: EEN: Caught the first fish since the Cape: a turtle [?].
Caught a shark that was 7 feet long.
Caught an owl at the top of the mast.
VINGEN EEN KONINGSVIS, ZEER GOED OM TE E: Caught a kingfish, very good to eat.
VINGEN EEN MALLEMOKS EN SIEN VERSCHIJDE: Caught a fulmar and see several, and likewise gannets.
VINGEN EEN SOORT BRUINVIS VAN DE ZOGENAA: Caught a kind of porpoise, of the so-called farmer with his pigs!
VINGEN EEN VLIEGENDE VIS DIE OP DE BAK K: Caught a flying fish that flew onto the forecastle.
VINGEN EEN VOGEL VAN HET SOORT DER ALBAT: Caught a bird of the albatross kind.
VINGEN EEN ZEEVOGEL MET DE GEDAANTE VAN: Caught a seabird shaped like a duck, with the bill of a heron and mouse-gray in color.
VINGEN EEN ZOO ROGGEN EN WEINIG ANDERE V: Caught a [?] of rays and little other fish.
VINGEN IN DE EW VERSCHILLENDE OXHOOFDEN: Took on board several hogsheads of water in the [?].
VINGEN KOOLVISCH, SCHELVIS EN TWEE HAAYE: Caught coalfish, haddock and two sharks.
VINGEN VEEL VI. ZIEN 3 WILDE EENDVOGELS: Caught many fish. See 3 wild ducks and other land birds.
VINGEN VEEL VIS EN DOLFIJNEN. VOGELS BIJ: Caught much fish and dolphins. Birds near the ship.
VINGEN WATER VOOR HET VEE. SCHEEPSRAAD:: Took on water for the livestock. Ship's council: 4 invalids.
VINGEN WATER, GAVEN ZUURKOOL AAN DE SCHE: Took on water, gave sauerkraut to the crew.
VINIENDO EN NUESTRA CONSERVA LA FRAGATA: Coming in our convoy the frigate Santa Margarita and the schooner Santa Engracia.
VIS GEVANGEN VOOR HELE SCHEEPSVOLK: Fish caught for the whole ship's company.
VISHOEKER HAD DE VISSERBANK 1 MIJL WEST,: The fishing hooker had the fishing bank 1 mile west, and with that 19g45min (instead of 17g37min), took this over.
VISIBLES EN LA MAR MUCHOS HILEROS DE COR: Many streaks of currents visible in the sea. The inflow of water was not stopped despite the efforts.
VISITE EN CONTRA VISITE, CEREMONIEEL. ZI: Visit and return visit, ceremonial. See mountains heavily covered with snow and see much water falling [?].
VISITEERDE HET GESCHUT, KEREN KRUIT: Inspected the guns, turned the gunpowder.
VISITEERDEN DE KRUITKAMER, 342 DOOR DE R: Inspected the powder room, 342 damaged by the rats.
VISITEERDEN DE KRUITKAMER: 178 KARDOELEN: Inspected the powder room: 178 cartridges gnawed to pieces by mice.
VISITEERDEN DE KRUITKAMER: IN ORDE. OVER: Inspected the powder room: in order. Sailor J. van Sus died.
VISITEREN DE BATTERIJ: BLEEK DROOG TE ZI: Inspect the battery: found to be dry.
VISITEREN DE BOONIKOOI, NOG VOOR 8 WEKEN: Inspect the bean store, still enough for 8 weeks, for the slaves 7 weeks of maize.
VISITEREN DE BROODKAMER: GEEN LEKKAGE WE: Inspect the bread room: no leakage, but moldy and spoiled bread. Fetch the sick from under the half deck over there and clean it. Do everything to offer them comfort. Provost Cornelis Danne of Vlissingen died.
VISITEREN DE KRUITKAMER: ALLE SCHERPE PA: Inspect the powder room: all live cartridges damaged by rats.
VISITEREN DE PLUNJE VAN HET VOLK. VOLK K: Inspect the crew's clothing. The crew complains about the poor quality of the yellow peas for the pea soup.
Inspect the sails and the sail locker.
Inspect the sail locker and the bread rooms. Much bread is spoiling. See a comet star [?].
VISSEN HET ANKERTOUW VAN HET DAAGS ANKER: Fish up the anchor cable of the day anchor and come to lie well moored.
VISTA DE LOBOS Y PATOS: Sight of sea lions and ducks.
VISVLIET DOET SEIN, MAAR WE WETEN NIET W: The fishing boat gives a signal, but we do not know why.
VLAG HALFSTOK OMDAT LUITENANT GEEFKES VA: Flag at half-mast because Lieutenant Geefkes of the Princes Louisa has died. Brought a sick sailor, Barnardes Jans, ashore. He died ashore shortly afterwards.
VLAG TEN TOP GEHANGEN T.E.V. VERJAARDAG: Flag hoisted to the top in honor of the birthday of Her Royal Highness Madam the Princess of Orange.
VLAGEN, DAARNA BUIIG MET REGENVLAGEN: Squalls, afterwards showery with rain squalls.
VLAGGEN GEHEZEN VOOR VERJAARDAG VAN HARE: Flags hoisted for the birthday of Her Royal Highness Madam the Princess of Orange.
VLAGGEN MET GEUS EN WIMPEL, EN VIEREN DE: Flags with jack and pennant, and celebrate the birthday of the Prince of Orange.
VLAGGEN UITGEBREID MET DE HOLLANDSE, PRU: Flags extended with the Dutch, Prussian and Russian flags in honor of the birthday of the King of the Netherlands, 3 times long live the King! Promotions of various men, extra genever.
Meat soup given to the crew.
VLGS NIEUWE WASSENDE GRADIGE PASKAART VA: According to the new Mercator chart of Brazil.
VLGS TIJDMETER LENGTE ST. ANTONIO O W/Z: By chronometer longitude St. Antonio E W/S [?] northerly 185.25 miles and Tobago WSW 1/4 W 330 miles.
VLGS TIJDMETER LEZARD NW 3/4 W 10,5 MIJL: By chronometer longitude Lizard NW 3/4 W 10.5 miles and Hijzand SSW 1/2 W 16.5 miles.
VLIEGENDE STORM DIER GELIJKEN IK WEIJNIG: Racing storm, the like of which I have rarely heard.
VLIEGENDE STORM. SYMBOOL Z07 MET 2 STREE: Racing storm. Symbol Z07 with 2 little lines underneath.
VLIEGENDE VIS. VURING IN 'T WATER: Flying fish. Phosphorescence in the water.
VM: HET WEER BEDAARDE. GEBETERDE KOERS E: Forenoon: the weather moderated. Corrected course and distance NO 2/3 N, 3 miles. Changed longitude 7'.
VM: TOT 12 UUR ZETTEN WIJ ONZE KOERS OTZ: Forenoon: until 12 o'clock we set our course east by south on the magnetic compass, because we found ourselves at the latitude of Cabo das Palmas.
VM: WINDKRACHT: MET TRAVATEN UIT HET ONO: Forenoon: wind force: with squalls from the east-northeast. Forenoon: the wind variable, now west, now east, now south. HW: the current set us onto the shore.
VM: ZIEN HET LAND MET EEN BERG MET EEN S: Forenoon: see the land, with a mountain with a saddle in the middle. Took it for Cape Monte.
VM: ZIEN PORTO SANTO IN HET WTN, (GIS) 8: Forenoon: see Porto Santo west by north (estimated) 8.5 miles. Changed meridian to the west by 26.5 miles. Afternoon and PV: bearing of Porto Santo west by north (estimated) 4.5 miles.
Forenoon watch: 8 glasses, course west, 8 miles.
VMW: LATEN HET ANKER VALLEN OP 18,5 VAAM: Forenoon watch: let the anchor fall in 18.5 fathoms of water. Current since yesterday noon 12 o'clock: 15 miles due west reckoned. Calculate for this 2° 39' longitude (?).
VMW: POMPTEN LENS VMW: TAPTEN WEER IN AM: Forenoon watch: pumped the bilge. Forenoon watch: tapped again [?]. Afternoon watch: pumped 9 inches from the bilge.
VMW: ZON-MAAN AFSTAND GEEFT 99° 50' OL E: Forenoon watch: sun-moon distance gives 99° 50' east longitude and the chronometer 100° east longitude.
VMW? OF WIND EN WEER GEDURENDE DE HELE D: Forenoon watch? Or wind and weather during the whole day?
VOEREN DOOR NAAR ST. MARTIN EN LAGEN DAA: Sailed on to St. Martin and lay there in the bay until 14 October.
VOEREN OP 18 AUGUSTUS WEG UIT TEXEL: Sailed away from Texel on 18 August.
VOGELS EN VLIEGENDE VISSEN BIJ HET SCHI: Birds and flying fish around the ship.
VOLGEN 4 DAGEN ZONDER BESTEK: Following 4 days without a reckoned position.
VOLGEND DE NIEUWE ENGELSE KAART LIGT MAY: According to the new English chart, Mayde lies 2°2' more easterly and 0°38' more southerly than on other charts.
VOLGENDE MORGEN VERDRONK DEN JONGE JAN G: The following morning the young Jan Gerritsen, coming from the yard, fell overboard and drowned. The same fate befell the marines' corporal Willem van Soest, who in the afternoon, while catching a shark, fell overboard and also drowned.
VOLGENS 5 GENOMEN AFSTANDEN VAN ZON EN M: According to 5 distances taken of sun and moon and the chronometer observations, we were at 0°59' east of Greenwich.
According to 5 distances taken of sun and moon and the chronometer observations, we were at 2° 22' 20'' east of Greenwich.
VOLGENS AFSTANDEN TUSSEN CON*ANTARES TEN: According to the average of distances between Con*Antares to the east and Reulus to the west, the longitude is 342.29.
VOLGENS BESTEK 3GR31M TE OOSTELIJK: According to the reckoning 3°31' too far east.
VOLGENS BESTEK DE EQUATOR NWTN 20 MIJL O: According to the reckoning the equator bears northwest by north, 20 miles, at the longitude of 22 degrees 0 minutes.
According to the reckoning, Captain Oosthuijsen: St. Jago west-northwest, 6 miles.
VOLGENS BESTEK OPKLARENDE DE ZUIDHOEK VA: According to the reckoning, clearing up, the south point of Porto Santo.
VOLGENS BEVONDEN BREEDTE EN TIJDMETERSLE: According to the latitude found and the chronometer longitude, we had been set 13 miles to the southeast 7/8 east outside the reckoning.
According to the latitude found and the chronometer longitude, in the day we had been set 5.25 miles off course to the north by east 3/4 east.
VOLGENS BEVONDEN LENGTE DE OOSTHOEK VAN: According to the longitude found, the east point of the Visbaai north-northwest, 8.5 miles.
VOLGENS CHRONOMETER LOOPT DE STROOM N 50: According to the chronometer the current runs N 50° W, 5.75 miles in the day.
According to the atlas of Hoveburg.
VOLGENS DE BEVONDEN BREEDTE IS DE GEBETE: According to the latitude found, the corrected distance made is 28 miles on the aforementioned course.
VOLGENS DE BEVONDEN LENGTE KAAP MONTAGNE: According to the longitude found, Kaap Montagne east by north, 20 miles.
VOLGENS DE BEVONDEN LENGTE WAS MOGENES O: According to the longitude found, Mogenes was east 1/4 north, 51 miles and the Engelshoofd north by east, 27 miles, for which reason the reckoning must be put more to the west.
VOLGENS DE ENGELSE KAART VAN NORRIE UIT: According to the English chart of Norrie from 1815.
VOLGENS DE FRANSE REVOLUTIONAIRE KALENDE: According to the French Revolutionary calendar this should be 1 Brumaire II. Vendem 30.
VOLGENS DE HOLLANDSE KAART 46°17'. (GISL: According to the Dutch chart 46°17'. (Estimated longitude according to Tenerife: 43°44'E)
VOLGENS DE HOLLANDSE KAART 9 MIJL TE OOS: According to the Dutch chart 9 miles too far east, according to the French chart 16 miles too far east.
VOLGENS DE HOLLANDSE KAART DER COMMISSIE: According to the Dutch chart of the Commission.
According to the chart of the Commission.
According to the chart of Norie.
VOLGENS DE KAART VAN STEEL: According to the chart of Steel.
VOLGENS DE KAART VAN VAN KUELEN OP 33° Z: According to the chart of Van Kuelen at 33° south latitude and 34°55' longitude, so our reckoning is 4°31' or 56.75 miles too far east.
VOLGENS DE LAATSTE LENGTE KOMT MAURITIUS: According to the latest longitude Mauritius bears west 1/2 north, 40 miles.
VOLGENS DE MIDDAGBREEDTE STONDEN TEGEN D: According to the noon latitude we were up against the shore at Wia Wia. A proof that this land lies too far north on the chart, since we were still 2 to 2.25 miles off the shore.
VOLGENS DE TIJDMEETERS VAN DE HEER VAILL: According to the chronometers of Mr Vaille we would have been set 30 to 40 minutes to the west in the day. Having already the longitude of 5°17', so that we actually crossed the line between 6 and 5 degrees.
VOLGENS DE TIJDMETER STOND MEN 1° OP DE: According to the chronometer we were 1° up on the shore.
VOLGENS DE TIJDMETERS MOESTEN WIJ DIT EI: According to the chronometers we should already see this island. The 'East India Pilot' makes no mention of this island. Decided to seek out the island Diego Garcia.
VOLGENS DIEN KOMT HET BESTEK BIJ DE GOUG: According to that, the reckoning comes at the Goughs Rocks.
VOLGENS DIEN PUNTO DE FRONTAL INT W1/3N: According to that, Punto de Frontal bears west 1/3 north, 44 miles from us.
VOLGENS DIEN STONDE MET ONS BESTEK OP HE: According to that, we stood with our reckoning on the island of Madeira, but discovered no land.
VOLGENS DIEPTE ZOUDEN WIJ LENGTE 19G10MI: According to the depth we would have longitude 19°10'.
VOLGENS DIT JOURNAAL IS ST. ANNA 1 DER A: According to this journal St. Anna is one of the Azores or Flemish Islands.
VOLGENS GISSING BEVINDT HET SCHIP ZICH O: According to estimate the ship is at the latitude of the island Sint Brandao.
VOLGENS GISSING DE ZON EN DE TROPICUS CA: According to estimate passed the sun and the Tropic of Capricorn.
VOLGENS HET BESTEK DE BAXOS DE ABREOLHAS: According to the reckoning passed the Baxos de Abreolhas. Kept a good lookout.
VOLGENS HET BESTEK VAN HET GEPRAAIDE SCH: According to the reckoning of the hailed ship I should have had Claps Island 3 miles north of me, which was not the case, so that the reckoning did not work out.
VOLGENS HET BESTEK WAS MEN 2 MIJL UIT DE: According to the reckoning we were 2 miles from the nearest shore, while it was estimated at 5 miles. After recalculation and comparison with other charts the reckoning is corrected.
VOLGENS HET BESTEK ZOUDEN ZE DE ALGOA BA: According to the reckoning they should have passed Algoa Bay. The position is being compared with other charts.
VOLGENS HET EILAND ST. ANTHONIE 5 GRADEN: According to the island St. Anthonie we were 5 degrees more to the west than we estimated. We were 5 degrees more westerly than we estimated.
VOLGENS HET FRANSE ZEEBOEK VAN DE HEER D: According to the French sea book of Mr d'Après de Mannevillette they found themselves between the point of Baai Content and the point called Sondernaam, east of the same (Caab de Serias).
VOLGENS HET SCHUTBLAD BEGINT DEZE REIS O: According to the cover sheet this voyage begins on 9 October 1662. Data about the ship or about the first days of the voyage are missing.
VOLGENS INDISCHE PILOTE 5GR7MIN TE WESTE: According to the Indian Pilot 5°7' too far west.
VOLGENS KAART EAST INDIA PILOT: KAAP HEN: According to the chart East India Pilot: Kaap Henry west by north, 60 miles; Sandy Hook northwest by north, 66 miles.
VOLGENS LAATSTE OBSERVATIE DE LENGTE 111: According to the latest observation the longitude is 111 degrees 15 minutes.
VOLGENS LAATSTE OBSERVATIE LENGTE 104 GR: According to the latest observation the longitude is 104 degrees 25 minutes.
VOLGENS LOOD 89°15' OL LOODDEN VAN 44 TO: According to the lead 89°15' east longitude, soundings from 44 to 11 fathoms, at 11 N.M. later assuming.
VOLGENS OBSERVATIE IS DE TIJDMETER OP DE: According to observation the chronometer at noon (on this day) is 11' 10'' ahead of Greenwich mean time and runs 4' 5'' too fast in the day. Bearings on Kaap de Goede Hoop and Kaap Fals come, according to the English chart book, at 34° 32' south latitude and 18° 29' east longitude.
VOLGENS ONS BESTEK LIGT AMSTERDAM 60 MIJ: According to our reckoning Amsterdam lies 60 miles more easterly than on the chart; corrected the reckoning.
VOLGENS ONS BESTEK MOESTEN WE DICHT BIJ: According to our reckoning we should be close to land. We had not much latitude left, because the current carried us south daily.
VOLGENS TIJDMETERS LENGTE TER DIER TIJD: According to chronometer longitude at that time being 15°21' and 29°55' north latitude, the same (Salvages) bore west-northwest, 8.5 miles.
VOLGENS TIJDMETERSBESTEK IN HET ENGELSE: According to the chronometer reckoning in the English chart book.
VOLGENS TIJDMETERSBESTEK IN HET INDISCHE: According to the chronometer reckoning in the Indian chart book of Horstburgh.
VOLGENS TIJDMETERSBESTEK IN HET KAARTENB: According to the chronometer reckoning in the chart book.
VOLGENS TWEE GENOMEN AFSTANDEN VAN ZON E: According to two distances taken of sun and moon we were at 0°27' 30''.
VOLK BEKLAAGT ZICH OVER DE STOKVIS, WIL: The crew complain about the stockfish and no longer want to eat it, but do want the water, butter and mustard that are used for it.
VOLK EXERCEERDE MET GESCHUT: The crew exercised with the guns.
VOLK VANGT VEEL SPRINGVIS OF HERETT OF K: The crew catch many jumping fish, or herett or kenoidt, some 13 in half an hour. The meat is like fresh beef, but dry in taste.
VOLLE MAAN. 'S AVONDS MAAN ECLIPS DIE GE: Full moon. In the evening a lunar eclipse that was total and very beautiful to see.
VONDEN DOOR ONS BESTEK 10,5 MIJL TE WEST: Found by our reckoning to be 10.5 miles too far west.
VONDEN EEN LEK IN EEN DER SPIJSKISTEN, W: Found a leak in one of the food chests, whereby the groats were completely spoiled.
Caught fish for the whole ship's company.
VOOR 'T EERST VLIEGENDE VIS EN EEN PIJLS: For the first time flying fish and a pintail; constantly have Cape pigeons near the ship. Strong phosphorescence.
VOOR DE 5DE MAAL DE EVENAAR GEPASSEERD: Crossed the equator for the 5th time.
VOOR DE HAVE VAN HELLEVOETSLUIJS TEN ANK: At anchor off the harbour of Hellevoetsluijs, found here the ships Schiedam, Kastor and Phenix.
VOOR DE KUST STREKKENDE ZOU DAT VAN KAAP: Stretching along the coast, that should have to be from Kaap Barbas to Kaap Blanc.
The weather somewhat moderated before noon.
VOOR DE MIDDAG ZAGEN WIJ ENKELDE KNOLLET: Before noon we saw a few small lumps of ice (first ice). At noon it became thicker with ice.
VOOR DE WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE WORDT DE GEM: For the true longitude obtained, the average chronometer longitude is taken.
VOOR DE ZESDE MAAL GEDURENDE DE REIS DE: Crossed the equator for the sixth time during the voyage.
VOOR DEZE DAG : NOORDERBREEDTE VAN 64°28: For this day: north latitude 64°28', longitude 16°6', and by distance to the moon the latitude was found to be 64°49'.
VOOR WIND EN WEER VAN EEN DAG WORDT HEEL: For wind and weather of a day, it very often refers back to the day before, often several days, so that the accuracy perhaps becomes somewhat more uncertain.
VOORGENOEMDE ARRESTANTEN UIT DE BOEIEN: The aforementioned prisoners out of irons.
VORM BEWOLKING: WOLKDRIJVENDE TOT BUIIG: Form of clouds: drifting clouds to gathering squalls, passing overhead sky.
VRAAGT RAPPORT AAN DE DOKTERS OVER DE ZI: Asks for a report from the doctors about the sick. Decide not to call at the Cape.
VREEMD SCHIP IN DE VERTE, DE UTRECHT HEI: Strange ship in the distance; the Utrecht hoists its flag but sees no flag on that ship, therefore flag down again.
VREESDEN DAT DE GOEDE WIND ONS ZOU VERLA: Feared that the good wind would leave us.
VROUWSLAAF OVERLEDEN, NR. 20 (192 SLAVEN: Female slave deceased, no. 20 (192 slaves in the ship).
VROUWSLAAF OVERLEDEN, NR. 60. NOG EEN VR: Female slave deceased, no. 60. Another female slave deceased 'of a wound', no. 61.
VROUWSLAAF OVERLEDEN. LIETEN TUSSENDEKS: Female slave deceased. Had the between-decks cleaned.
VROUWSLAAF VAN DE GENERAAL DE GIETERE GE: Female slave of the General de Gietere, marked CD, deceased.
Aforementioned seen, the whole day's run.
VU PLUSIEURS MORCEAUX D'ARBRES, ET DES B: Saw several pieces of trees, and whales.
VULDEN 4 WATERKISTEN A 1000 KAN MET ZOUT: Filled 4 water chests of 1000 cans each with salt water.
VULLEN EENIGE SCHERPE PATRONEN VOOR ZOWE: Filled some live cartridges for both flintlocks and pistols.
VULLEN ENIGE KARDOEZEN VOOR DE 30 EN 18: Filled some cartridges for the 30- and 18-pounders, doubled the lookout.
Filling cartridges in the powder room.
Filling empty water casks with salt water.
VULLEN LEGGERS MET ZOUT WATER. ABSENT: S: Filling large casks with salt water. Absent: soldier Jan Mane of Luxembourg. Died: Jan Counraedt? Seijnhage of Alvergem.
VURING GELIJK BRANDING IN 'T WATER: Phosphorescence like surf in the water.
VURING IN 'T WATER, ZIEN TONIJNEN EN BOS: Phosphorescence in the water, see tuna and [?] and a few scissor birds and Cape pigeons.
VURING OF ZEEQUALLEN IN 'T WATER: Phosphorescence or jellyfish in the water.
VURINGS DAT ALS MET KLOMPEN OP 'T WATER: Phosphorescence that floated on the water as if with clogs. Extra many Cape pigeons, blue gulls, mallemuks, southern birds.
VUUR GEVECHT MET 2 ROVERS IN DE NACHT .W: Gunfight with 2 pirates in the night. Probably a French privateer, white pennant.
VW: IK (SCHRIJVER) LAS DE SENTENTIE OVER: VW: I (the clerk) read the sentence on the commander of the soldiers (all the ship's crew listened). The latter would be put ashore at the first opportunity, his pay would be confiscated, and he would never again be allowed to serve the country.
W LAND VAN BONAIRE NO 1/2 N: W, land of Bonaire NE 1/2 N.
WAARDOOR HET VOLK GESTADIG NAT WEIRD, EN: Because of this the people were constantly wet, and because of that more and more fell sick; we now already have 26 men in their bunks.
WAAREN DE TROPICUS CAPRICOMI GEPASSEERD: Had passed the Tropic of Capricorn.
WAARGENOMEN BUITEN DE MIDDAG=WARE BEKOME: Observed outside noon = true obtained latitude.
WAARNEMING TUSSEN DE ZON EN DE MAAN LEVE: Observation between the sun and the moon yields a longitude of 5°8'45''.
WAARNEMINGEN DRIEMAAL GENOTEERD, OM 8, 1: Observations noted three times, at 8, 16 and 0 hours. The 0 hour one was adopted.
WACHTEN TEN 6 UREN OP DE SCHOENERS DIE T: Waited at 6 o'clock for the schooners that belonged to the convoy.
WACHTVOLK EXERCEERT MET GESCHUT, VERSCHA: Watch crew exercises with the guns, barricaded with the bunks.
WAL CURAÇAO DICHT GENADERD TEN 5 UUR IN: Approached the shore of Curaçao closely at 5 o'clock in the day watch.
WANDLUIZEN ONTDEKT IN DE KOOIEN DER JAGE: Bedbugs discovered in the bunks of the hunters, we tried to drive them off.
WANNEER 'S AVONDS HET EILAND AMSTERDAM I: When the island Amsterdam comes into sight in the evening, the longitude is determined anew. The course and distance since noon is ENE 12 miles. The new longitude is: 92 deg. 18 min. The island Amsterdam lies at a longitude of 92 deg. 18 min.
WANNEER DE TEMPERATUUR EN LUCHTDRUK SLEC: When the temperature and air pressure are given for only one watch, they are simply noted; when the temperature and air pressure are given for more than one watch, I will state the figures that fall as close as possible to the forenoon watch.
WANNEER ER SPRAKE IS VAN 'S NACHTS OF IN: When there is mention of 'at night' or in the HW (dog watch), it always concerns the end of the day or the early start of the next day.
WARE BEKOMEN BREEDTE BUITEN DE MIDDAG. V: True obtained latitude outside noon. Changed longitude 0° 19'.
WARE BEKOMEN BREEDTE IS DE RUIGE BEVONDE: True obtained latitude is the rough found latitude.
WARE BEKOMEN BREEDTE IS RUIGE BEVONDEN B: True obtained latitude is rough found latitude.
True obtained latitude is rough found latitude (normally found latitude).
True obtained latitude is rough found latitude.
WARE BEKOMEN BREEDTE IS RUIJGE BEVONDEN: True obtained latitude is rough found latitude.
WARE BEKOMEN BREEDTE IS RUWE BEVONDEN BR: True obtained latitude is rough found latitude. According to the text it is rough found north latitude, according to the margin line it is rough found south latitude.
WARE BEKOMEN BREEDTE IS WEER RUIJW: True obtained latitude is again rough.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS GENOMEN VOLGENS N: True obtained longitude was taken according to no. 61. The true obtained longitude is also given according to no. 50 (35°8'24).

True obtained longitude was taken according to no. 61. The true obtained longitude is also given according to no. 50 (37°22'). Coast chart no. 22 and chart no. 18 differ by 1 degree regarding St. Antonio near Bahia.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS HIER BEVONDEN TIJ: True obtained longitude is here the found chronometer longitude.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS HIER DE BEVONDEN: True obtained longitude is here the found longitude.
True obtained longitude is here the found chronometer longitude.

True obtained longitude is here the found chronometer longitude. Island Trinidad lies according to the French chart at 20 degrees 32 minutes south latitude and 27 degrees 20 minutes longitude west of Paris, according to the Spanish at 20 degrees 35 minutes south latitude and 29 degrees 12 minutes longitude west of Paris, and according to the English sea book at 20 degrees 15 minutes south latitude and 31 degrees 0 minutes longitude west of Paris.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS STEEDS DE TIJDMET: True obtained longitude is always the chronometer longitude, unless stated otherwise.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS STEEDS HET GEMIDD: True obtained longitude is always the average of chronometers no. 85 and no. 86.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS TIJDMETER LENGTE: True obtained longitude is chronometer longitude.
True obtained longitude is chronometer longitude. Transferring the reckoning, clearing sky, the English [?] of W. Heather, 1826.
True obtained longitude is chronometer longitude. On this day 3 chronometers: nos. 2, 5 and 7.
True obtained longitude is chronometer longitude. Direction and distance of Finisterre according to the chart of Piondez.
True obtained longitude is chronometer longitude. Observed meter 64º 14'.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS TIJDMETER NR. 699: True obtained longitude is chronometer no. 699.
True obtained longitude is chronometer no. 94.
True obtained longitude is chronometer longitude.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE IS VANAF HIER TIJDME: True obtained longitude is from here chronometer no. 822.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE STAAT HIER VOOR VERB: True obtained longitude stands here for corrected longitude. Sombrera standing 2 degrees miles from us (?). At half past 7 the found longitude of the Ajax was 319 degrees and the latitude 18 degrees 26 minutes.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS 'ZON EN MAAN': True obtained longitude according to 'sun and moon'.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER: True obtained longitude according to chronometer.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER OM 4: True obtained longitude according to chronometer at 4 o'clock in the afternoon.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER, IN O: True obtained longitude according to chronometer, the original says: 10° 49' 52.5'' west of Greenwhich.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer, the original says: 10° 8' 10.5'' west of Greenwhich.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER. DIEP: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Depths 45-38 fathoms, mud bottom.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER. LENG: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Longitude according to sun and moon 25° 37'.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Longitude according to sun and moon 28° 20'.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Longitude according to sun and moon 32° 44'.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Longitude according to sun and moon 35° 30'.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER. PEIL: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Bearing the Devil's Islands SW by W. Remarks about the reckoning and the chronometer.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer. At 12.00 o'clock bearing the W point of Cape Mouath ? N by E 1/2 E and the E point of Cape Mouath ? NNE.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS TIJDMETER. SEDE: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. For 2 days now each day 10' set to the north, so we have a current running toward the NW.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VLGS ZON EN MAAN: True obtained longitude according to sun and moon.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS LANDPEILING: True obtained longitude according to land bearing.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS OBSERVATIE Z: True obtained longitude according to observation of sun and moon, according to sight of the shore: 74°10.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS TIJDMETEN: True obtained longitude according to chronometer.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS TIJDMETER: True obtained longitude according to chronometer.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS TIJDMETER. G: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. No bottom. See no land.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS TIJDMETER. M: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. With 50 fathoms black mud.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS TIJDMETER. O: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. At 12 o'clock bearing the rock Bassa N 1/2 E. The hill ? OTW 1/4 E.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE VOLGENS TIJDMETER. P: True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Bearing Gronan ? NE 1/2 E. No bottom with 120 fathoms.
True obtained longitude according to chronometer. Bearing St. Joaks (?) river NE 1/2 E (St. John?) and bearing Cape Mesurado NE by N.
WARE BEKOMEN LENGTE WORDT GENOEMD: HERLE: True longitude obtained is called: reduced chronometer longitude, it is a very extensive journal in which especially.
WARE LENGTE IS DE LENGTE DIE TIJDMTER NO: True longitude is the longitude that chronometer no. 46 indicates. On board were also the chronometers 809 and 248.
WARE VOORNEMENS NA T VADERLANDT TE VERTR: Truly intended to depart for the fatherland since we learned nothing and could not get past the ice because of the south-east wind
WAREN 1 GRAAD 33 MIN WESTELIJKER ALS MET: Were 1 degree 33 minutes more westerly than by our dead reckoning
WAREN 2 1/4 GR OOSTELIJKER ALS ONS BESTE: Were 2 1/4 degrees more easterly than our dead reckoning
Were 2° more easterly than we estimated.
WAREN 5 GRADEN 5 MINUTEN OOSTELIJKER ALS: Were 5 degrees 5 minutes more easterly than we estimated
WAREN 53 MIJL OOSTELIJKER ALS HET SCHIP: Were 53 miles more easterly than the ship
WAREN 56.75 MIJL WESTELIJKER DAN HET BES: Were 56.75 miles more westerly than the dead reckoning.
WAREN 7 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZET: Were set 7 minutes to the north
WAREN DE ABROLHOS GEPASSEERT DEDEN EEN D: Passed the Abrolhos, gave thanks to God
WAREN DE DATUMGRENS GEPASSEERD, (WOENSDA: Crossed the date line (Wednesday 23 April 1828 was omitted, only when they arrive in China, I have however already switched to the new date here)
WAREN DE DIEPTES GEPASSEERD (…) GRAUW ZA: Passed the depths (…) coarse sand with broken shells and white specks.
Passed the shoal of Haminco. N 23°35' longitude 313°30'
WAREN DE LINIE EQUINOCTIAAL GEPASSEERD O: Crossed the equinoctial line at chronometer longitude 24°38' west of the meridian of Greenwich.
WAREN DE NIEUW ONTDEKTE KLIP VAN 17?9 LE: Passed the newly discovered rock of 17?9 lying on the new chart, clearing sky 14:30 south-west
WAREN DE ZON ALSMEDE DE TROPICUS CAPRICO: Passed the sun as well as the Tropic of Capricorn
WAREN DIT ETMAAL 17' NOORDELIJKER DAN RE: Were 17' further north this day than by dead reckoning
WAREN DOOR DES HEEREN GOEDHEID DE AMBROL: By the Lord's goodness passed the Abrolhos
Were thus set 26' into the course.
WAREN HET ZUIDEN VAN DE TROPICUS GEPASSE: Passed to the south of the tropic.
WAREN MET GODS HULP TROPIC OF CAPRICORN: With God's help crossed the Tropic of Capricorn
WAREN NA GEDAGTE NIET VER VANT IJS AF: Were, as thought, not far from the ice
WAREN NIET VER VAN DE VASTE KUST VAN HET: Were not far from the solid edge of the ice
WAREN NIET VERSTOPTE VAN DE KUST VAN T W: Were not hidden from the coast of the West Ice
WAREN OP DE BINNENKANT VAN DE BREEVEERTI: Were on the inner side of the [?]
WAREN OP DE BREEDTE VAN HET EIALND DIOGO: Were at the latitude of the island Diogo Rodrigus
WAREN VLGS DIEN 'T EILAND ST PAULUS EN A: Were according to that past the islands St Paul and Amsterdam, but saw nothing
WAREN VOLGENS DE BREEDTE STERK OM DE NOO: Were set strongly to the north according to the latitude.
Were off the coast of South America.
WAREN WEER 1 GRAAD 5 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD: Were again set 1 degree 5 minutes to the north
WAREN WEER 33 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZET: Were again set 33 minutes to the north
WAREN WEER 58 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZET: Were again set 58 minutes to the north
WAS= WASSENDE GRADIGE PASKAARTEN. EVEN=E: Was = increasing-degree charts. Even = equal-degree charts.
WATER AAN BOORD GENOMEN. BOTTELIERSMAAT: Took on water. Boatswain's mate David Zoetermeer died (f.233)
WATER VERANDERD VAN DONKERBLAUW IN DONKE: Water changed from dark blue to dark green
WATER VERANDERDE. KONDEN GEEN LAND ZIEN: Water changed. Could not see land because of the hazy sky, but were on the shoals of St. Anna
WATER VERANDERT, VIS GING VAN 'T SCHIP A: Water changes, fish left the ship
WATERDEN DE ZWARE TOUWEN.WEST MERIDIAAN: Watered the heavy ropes. West meridian 44.5 miles. Changed 18.25 miles W. Obtained 62.5 miles.
WATERDIEPTE GEMETEN, 100 VADEM (?) GEEN: Measured water depth, 100 fathoms (?) no bottom
WE BEMERKTEN DE LAGE THERMOMETERSTAND, D: We noticed the low thermometer reading, which was also described in Purdy, p. 513, in the vicinity of the Canary Islands. Although in the month of June the sun was always high and brought fine weather with a light breeze, 70 degrees (Fahrenheit) was seldom reached. The barometer too stood low as long as the wind was west and south of it, and only began, but then also steadily, to rise when the wind veered north of west. This agrees well with what Purdy on p. 514 therefore says
WE BEVONDEN ONZE KOERS DAGELIJKS NOORDEL: We found our course daily more northerly than we estimated, so that we suspected the current ran strongly to the northwest
WE BLEKEN NIET MISGEGIST TE HEBBEN: We turned out not to have misestimated
WE DACHTEN DAT 'T LAND DE HOEK VAN GOUDS: We thought the land was the Hoek van Goudstaardt, but because of the heavy fog we could not identify it
WE DACHTEN DAT HET EERSTE LAND DAT WE ZA: We thought the first land we saw was Bonna Vista, but we could not estimate the distance because of the haze on the horizon. The second land we saw should be the island Maijo, but we could not estimate its distance either because of the haze on the horizon.
WE DACHTEN DAT HET WATER VERANDERD WAS: We thought the water had changed
WE DACHTEN DOOR HET DRIJVENDE KROOST DAT: From the drifting spawn we thought we were further west than yesterday
WE HADDEN GEDURENDE DE NACHT VEEL ZUID G: During the night we had made much southing, so we decided not to hold on any further and instead of Madera to use the island Palma for verifying the chronometer
WE KREGEN EEN SLOEP VAN EEN ENGELS SCHIP: We had a boat from an English ship come aboard, it came from London. The name of the ship is Anna, the name of the captain Wm-_Stoonij
WE KREGEN VAN ANDERE SCHEPEN TE HOREN DA: We heard from other ships that the whole town at Cape Francois had been burned by the Negroes and that these Negroes did not want to surrender.
WE VERMISTEN ONZE MAET JAN DE KOK: We missed our mate Jan the cook
WE VOEREN DOOR EEN PLEK GEHEEL WIT GEKLE: We sailed through a patch of completely white-coloured water, which we took for fish spawn
WE WAREN 18 MINUTEN NOORDELIJKER ALS WE: We were 18 minutes further north than we estimated
WE WAREN WEER 30 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZ: We were again set 30 minutes to the north
WE WAREN WEER 31 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZ: We were again set 31 minutes to the north
WE WAREN WEER 46 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZ: We were again set 46 minutes to the north
WE WAREN WEER 47 MINUTEN OM DE NOORD GEZ: We were again set 47 minutes to the north
WE ZAGEN 'S MORGEN DEZELFDE VERANDERINGE: In the morning we saw the same changes in the water as the previous day. The true longitude obtained here is the longitude found by chronometer
WEDUWE VAN WIJLEN KAPITEIN VAN LEEUWEN O: Widow of the late Captain Van Leeuwen died
WEER ONDER ZEIL. STUURDEN OTN EN ONO, 0,: Under sail again. Steered NNE and ENE, 0.5 mile off the shore, depth 10 and 11 fathoms.
Again some Cape pigeons near the ship.
WEER- EN WINDGEGEVENS: NIET BEKEND VAN W: Weather and wind data: not known for which watch. For the day?
WEERLIGT IN 'T OOST EN OTNO: Lightning in the east and ENE
WEGENS BRUTALITEIT TEGEN DE OFFICIER VAN: For brutality towards the administration officer, the officers' cook Duffels was put in irons, bent over, on water and bread for 3 times 24 hours
WEGENS OMBETAMELIJKE UITDRUKKINGEN IN AR: For improper language the marine J. Bundels was placed under arrest
WEGENS ONGEOORLOOFD VERLATEN VAN DE POST: For leaving his post as sentry without permission, marine Blanken was put in irons on water and bread
WEGENS VECHTERIJ IN DE BOEIEN DE OFFICIE: For fighting, the officers' cook Hagen and the baker Rhelemeijer were put in irons.
WEGENS VERREGAANDE LIEDERLIJKHEID EN ONG: For extreme dissoluteness and unfitness, officers' cook J. Duffels was demoted to sailor 3rd class
WEGENS VERREGAANDE LIEDERLIJKHEID OFFICI: For extreme dissoluteness, officer Duffels was put in irons, bent over, for 8 days
WEGENS VERREGAANDE MORSIGHEID WERD DE MA: For extreme sullenness, sailor 3rd class Sporry was placed under arrest and the next day punished with 48 lashes. The officers' cook Duffels was put in irons, bent over, for 24 hours for spoiling the food through indifference, laziness or unwillingness
WEGENS VERREGAANDE NALATIGHEID EN PLICHT: For extreme negligence and dereliction of duty, the 2nd sailmaker J.W. Hamel was put in irons, bent over, on water and bread
WEGENS VERZUIM VAN DIENST GEDEGRADEERD T: For neglect of duty, quartermaster G. Hennen was demoted to sailor 1st class and sailor 1st class P. Peterson was promoted to quartermaster
WEGENS ZIEKTE VAN DE KLTZ WORD BESLOTEN: Because of the illness of the [?] it is decided to go back to Porte Cabello.
WEINIG OF GEEN VOORTGANG MET SCHIP: Little or no progress with the ship
WENDDE TEN 9UUR OM DE ZO EN TEN 11UUR OM: Tacked at 9 o'clock to the southeast and at 11 o'clock to the west when the wind went to the southwest. True longitude obtained according to chronometer
Tacking with the 6 glasses of the afternoon watch to the northwest.
WENDEN MET DE 8 GLAZEN DER DW MET DEN ST: Tacking with the 8 glasses of the afternoon watch with the bow to the south.
WENDEN OVER DE VOORDELIGSTE BOEGEN: Tacking over the most favourable tacks
WERDEN DOOR ENGELSEN ONDERZOCHT OP WAPEN: Were searched for weapons by the English.
WERDEN DOOR NEPTUNUS GEPRAAID. HEZEN VLA: Were hailed by Neptune. Hoisted flag and pennant and celebrated the Neptune festival.
WERDEN MET DE STROOM STERK OM DE ZUID GE: Were pulled strongly to the south by the current.
WERDEN MET DE ZEE STERK OM DE Z GEZET. K: Were set strongly to the S by the sea. Could not get a latitude because of the nearness of the sun.
WERDEN STERK OM DE N GEZET: Were set strongly to the N.
WERKTEN OP EN KWAMEN DE 22E (AAN IN) BAT: Worked up and arrived at Batavia on the 22nd.
WERKTEN TUSSEN DE STROOKJES IJS DOOR: Worked their way between the strips of ice.
WERPEN HET LOOD DOCH KREGEN MET 140 VADE: Cast the lead but found no bottom at 140 fathoms.
